rules.name: shared-is-a-leaf
rules.reason: shared/ is the base layer; it cannot depend on packages or tooling

rules.name: packages-do-not-use-scripts
rules.reason: scripts/ is repository tooling, not extension runtime code

rules.name: packages-are-islands
rules.reason: share code through shared/; the except list is the cross-package imports that already existed when this file was written, so move one into shared/ and delete its line, and do not add to it
